# alison.com llms.txt

> Alison is a leading online learning platform dedicated to providing free courses and certifications that empower individuals to enhance their careers through accessible education. With a diverse library of over 6,000 courses across various fields such as Information Technology, Health, Business, and Personal Development, Alison enables learners to upskill and earn recognized diplomas and certificates. The platform is designed for professionals seeking career advancement, students pursuing additional qualifications, and organizations looking to train their employees, all while maintaining a commitment to free education for a global audience of over 50 million learners.

## Free Preview (20 of 18637 URLs)

- [Home](https://alison.com/): The homepage serves as the gateway to Alison's extensive catalog of free online courses and certifications. It highlights the platform's mission, showcases popular courses, and provides easy navigation for users to explore various subjects and learning paths.
- [About Alison Courses](https://alison.com/about/about-alison-courses): This page provides an overview of the types of courses offered by Alison, emphasizing the platform's commitment to free education. It details the course structure, learning outcomes, and the variety of subjects available, making it a valuable resource for prospective learners interested in understanding what they can achieve through Alison's offerings.
- [Accreditation](https://alison.com/about/accreditation): This section explains the accreditation status of Alison's courses and certifications, highlighting the recognition they receive from various educational and professional bodies. It reassures learners about the credibility of the qualifications they can earn, which is particularly beneficial for those looking to enhance their resumes.
- [Ads Free](https://alison.com/about/adsfree): This page outlines Alison's commitment to providing an ad-free learning experience. It explains how this approach enhances the user experience by allowing learners to focus solely on their education without distractions, thus appealing to those who value uninterrupted learning.
- [Board of Directors](https://alison.com/about/board-of-directors): Here, visitors can find information about the members of Alison's Board of Directors. This page provides insights into the leadership behind the platform, showcasing their expertise and commitment to advancing online education, which can instill confidence in potential users.
- [Careers](https://alison.com/about/careers): This page lists current job openings at Alison and provides information about the company culture and values. It is useful for job seekers interested in contributing to the online education sector and becoming part of a mission-driven organization.
- [Certification](https://alison.com/about/certification): This section details the certification process for learners who complete courses on Alison. It explains how to obtain certificates and diplomas, the types of certifications available, and their significance in professional development, making it essential for those looking to validate their skills.
- [Company Details](https://alison.com/about/company-details): This page offers a comprehensive overview of Alison as a company, including its founding, mission, and operational details. It serves to inform users about the organization's background and its dedication to making education accessible to all.
- [Course Classification](https://alison.com/about/course-classification): This page categorizes the courses available on Alison, helping users navigate the extensive library. It explains the different classifications and subjects, making it easier for learners to find courses that align with their interests and career goals.
- [EI Grant](https://alison.com/about/ei-grant): This section discusses Alison's Educational Initiative Grant, which supports the development of free educational resources. It highlights the platform's commitment to expanding access to education and can be of interest to educators and organizations involved in educational initiatives.
- [Go Premium](https://alison.com/about/gopremium): This page outlines the benefits of upgrading to Alison's premium membership. It details the additional features and resources available to premium users, appealing to learners who want to enhance their educational experience.
- [How It Works](https://alison.com/about/how-it-works): This section explains the user journey on Alison, from course selection to certification. It provides a step-by-step guide on how to navigate the platform, making it a helpful resource for new users looking to get started.
- [Learning on Alison](https://alison.com/about/learning-on-alison): This page describes the learning experience on Alison, including the interactive elements and support available to learners. It emphasizes the platform's user-friendly design and accessibility, which is crucial for individuals seeking flexible learning options.
- [Moving to Ireland](https://alison.com/about/moving-to-ireland): This section provides information for learners considering relocating to Ireland, including insights on the educational landscape and opportunities available. It can be particularly beneficial for international students or professionals looking to expand their horizons.
- [Our Story](https://alison.com/about/our-story): This page shares the history and founding story of Alison, detailing its mission to provide free education. It highlights the journey of the platform and its impact on millions of learners, fostering a connection with users who value the story behind the brand.
- [Our Team](https://alison.com/about/our-team): This section introduces the team behind Alison, showcasing the diverse backgrounds and expertise of its members. It helps to humanize the platform and builds trust with users by presenting the people dedicated to its mission.
- [Pricing](https://alison.com/about/pricing): This page outlines the pricing structure for Alison's premium services and any associated costs for certifications. It clarifies the financial aspects of using the platform, helping users make informed decisions about their learning investments.
- [Terms of Use](https://alison.com/about/terms-of-use): This section details the terms and conditions governing the use of Alison's platform. It is essential for users to understand their rights and responsibilities while using the site, ensuring a transparent user experience.
- [Tips for Applying to Alison](https://alison.com/about/tips-for-applying-to-alison): This page offers guidance for individuals interested in applying to work at Alison. It provides valuable tips and insights into the application process, making it a useful resource for prospective employees.
- [UN Sustainable Development Goals](https://alison.com/about/un-sustainable-development-goals): This section discusses Alison's alignment with the UN's Sustainable Development Goals, particularly in promoting quality education. It highlights the platform's commitment to global educational initiatives, appealing to socially conscious learners and organizations.

            $(document).on('click', '.menu-item', e => {
                e.preventDefault();

                let target = $(e.target),
                    other = $(e.target).parents('li').siblings().find('.sub-nav'),
                    menu = target.parent().find('.sub-nav');
                    menu.toggleClass('active');
                    other.removeClass('active');
            });

            $(document).on('click', '.icon-nb-menu', e => {
                e.preventDefault();

                $('html').toggleClass('no-scroll');
                $(e.target).toggleClass('active');
                $('.mobile-nav').toggleClass('open');
                
                if (!$(e.target).hasClass('active')) {
                    $('.sub-nav').hide().removeClass('open');
                }
                else {
                    $('.sub-nav').show();
                }
            });

            $(document).on('click', '.activate-subnav', e => {
                e.preventDefault();

                $(e.target).parent().find('.sub-nav').addClass('open');
            });
            
            $(document).on('click', '.subnav-back', e => {
                e.preventDefault();

                $('.sub-nav').removeClass('open');
            });
